channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Lula: Trump sabe que eu já falei para ele não se meter nas eleições do Brasil
item.description: Lula stated that he has already spoken with Trump to prevent any American interference in Brazil's 2026 elections. The president and reelection candidate said on Saturday that the US president knows he has been warned on the matter. The statement highlights diplomatic tensions between the two countries over electoral sovereignty.

item.title: Desembargador esclarece acusação de Grass sobre julgamento no TRE-DF
item.description: Desembargador Roberval Belinati clarified candidate Leandro Grass's accusation of being prejudiced in a TRE-DF ruling. Belinati stated he did not vote in the conviction since he only presided over the session and denied ever attempting to harm any litigant. The ruling was later overturned by the TSE, which unanimously absolved Grass.

item.title: “É preciso parar com essa babaquice de fazer superavit”, diz Lula
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva stated that the government should not prioritize a fiscal surplus, advocating public investments to spur economic growth and reduce public debt, blaming the deficit on high interest rates. He also pledged to allocate oil revenues from the Equatorial Margin to education, science, technology, and healthcare.

item.title: Flávio diz que quebra de sigilo no caso Dark Horse tem “impacto zero”
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro said that lifting secrecy in cases linked to Banco Master and the “Dark Horse” film has “zero impact,” citing the absence of new allegations as evidence of his integrity. He also demanded disclosure of the INSS and Lulinha cases, alleging that Lula’s government and the Supreme Court are trying to cover them up. The probes into the senator concern possible money laundering, capital flight and corruption crimes.

item.title: Caso Master: A arte de tentar se dar bem mesmo sendo culpado
item.description: The text examines how figures involved in the Master Case use persuasion techniques described by Schopenhauer to protect themselves and divert attention from accusations. Moraes, Flávio Bolsonaro, and other judiciary members are portrayed as part of an obfuscation strategy, attacking accusers instead of addressing facts. The author criticizes this stance, arguing that truth should prevail regardless of the political tactics employed.

item.title: 9ª cidade mais competitiva do Brasil com menos de 200 mil moradores: o município catarinense que lidera o estado em qualidade da educação e transparência
item.description: Jaraguá do Sul, in Santa Catarina, ranks as Brazil's 9th most competitive city with fewer than 200k residents, excelling in education quality and public transparency. The municipality enters the 2026 ranking leading its state in public management, outperforming state capitals and challenging the notion that only large centers deliver good governance. The piece highlights efficient public administration as a competitive edge for smaller cities.

item.title: O recado de Lula aos Bolsonaro sobre Vorcaro: ‘Eles pegaram um agiota e transformaram em banqueiro’
item.description: Lula claimed at a rally in Curitiba that the Bolsonaro family turned loan shark Daniel Vorcaro into a banker during the Bolsonaro administration, while his own government arrested and closed Banco Master. He also cited INSS fraud schemes hatched under the previous administration, involving the 'Careca do INSS' and Flávio Bolsonaro, reinforcing his narrative that corruption is a Bolsonarist legacy.

item.title: Flávio comemora fim de sigilo do Master e pede o mesmo no caso INSS
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), a presidential candidate, celebrated the lifting of secrecy on the Banco Master investigations at the STF and demanded the same for the INSS fraud case. He stated he is at ease with the exposure of facts and criticized the Lula government, calling for details of meetings involving banker Daniel Vorcaro and former Finance Minister Fernando Haddad to be made public. Flávio campaigned in Cabo Frio alongside Rio de Janeiro gubernatorial candidate Douglas Ruas.

item.title: Haddad pede caso Master “passado a limpo” antes das eleições
item.description: Fernando Haddad (PT) called for the Supreme Court cases related to the Banco Master scandal to be made public before the 2026 elections, defending an end to selective leaking of investigation information. The decision by STF President Edson Fachin to lift the secrecy on investigations precedes a plenary vote on whether to open an investigation against Minister Alexandre de Moraes.

item.title: A conversa de Lula com o chefe da PF sobre revelações do caso Master
item.description: Lula rejected calls to dismiss PF chief Andrei Rodrigues and kept him in office after Rodrigues denied receiving money from Daniel Vorcaro or protecting the banker in collusion with Alexandre de Moraes. Rodrigues also denied before the STF that he illegally monitored André Mendonça and Jorge Messias.

item.title: Botafogo x Bragantino no Brasileirão: onde assistir, horário e escalações
item.description: Botafogo and Red Bull Bragantino face off on Saturday, the 12th, at 8:30 PM Brasília time at Estádio Nilton Santos in the 27th round of the Brasileirão, broadcast exclusively on Amazon Prime Video. Botafogo aims to end a five-game winless streak, while Bragantino seeks to bounce back after two consecutive losses.

item.title: Ninguém pode ser ministro do STF para ficar rico, diz Lula
item.description: At a rally in Curitiba, Lula stated that Supreme Court justices should not serve to enrich themselves and called for investigations into their conduct. He criticized leaks from ongoing investigations and demanded the lifting of all secrecy orders in the Banco Master case, without naming Justice André Mendonça. He also reiterated his support for term limits for STF justices.

item.title: Lula chama Flávio de “frouxo” e diz que foi “acobertado pela imprensa”
item.description: Lula called Flavio Bolsonaro 'weak' and 'liar' during a rally in Curitiba, 22 days before the first round, claiming the national press favors his opponent. The president also recalled his 580 days in prison in Curitiba and cited a report linking a businessman to Flavio as evidence of shady connections.

item.title: Augusto Cury diz que vai 'fazer de tudo' para que metade das vagas em ministérios sejam ocupadas por mulheres
item.description: Augusto Cury (Avante) defended expanding full-time education and said he would do everything possible for women to hold half of ministerial posts. At an event for physicians, he also discussed mental health, violence against women, femicide, and the crisis at Brazil's Supreme Court.

item.title: “Quem fez putaria vai ser desmascarado, diz Lula”
item.description: At a rally in Curitiba, Lula said investigations into Daniel Vorcaro and Banco Master could expose misconduct involving politicians and described the businessman as a loan shark. He also connected the case to Jair Bolsonaro’s administration, defended probes into Lulinha, and criticized illicit enrichment in the Supreme Court.

item.title: Flávio diz que fim do sigilo de ‘Dark Horse’ tem ‘impacto zero’ na campanha: ‘Graças a Deus, caiu’
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro said the lifting of secrecy in the Master Case would have “zero impact” on his campaign and called the investigation’s disclosure an “endorsement of his integrity.” The probe into the Dark Horse biopic continues, with new lines of inquiry involving Mario Frias’s parliamentary amendments and the origin of the R$134 million Flávio requested from Daniel Vorcaro.

item.title: Lula faz críticas a Mendonça e defende quebra de sigilo do Master em comício
item.description: Lula defended the complete lifting of secrecy in the Banco Master case and criticized STF rapporteur André Mendonça during a rally in Curitiba. He stated that full disclosure would expose corrupt individuals and said he would not protect his son Lulinha if implicated in INSS fraud. The president sought to respond to the unprecedented crisis at the Court while trailing 16 points behind Flávio Bolsonaro in Paraná polling.

item.title: O mapa da audiência de Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro e Augusto Cury na TV
item.description: BTG/Nexus survey shows TV viewership: Lula leads with 38%, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro with 37% and Augusto Cury with 29%. While the ratings are close, the audience profiles differ significantly across candidates.

item.title: “Transformaram agiota em banqueiro”, diz Lula sobre Vorcaro
item.description: Lula accused the Banco Master of being propelled by allies of Jair Bolsonaro and said Daniel Vorcaro went from loan shark to banker. The PGR requested Vorcaro’s arrest after secrecy was lifted in probes involving the bank and the “Dark Horse” biopic, with Flávio and Eduardo Bolsonaro identified by the PF as the connection and money administrator, respectively.

item.title: Haddad defende publicidade de processos do caso Master 'antes da eleição' e 'sem viés de seleção'
item.description: Fernando Haddad urged the STF to disclose, before the election, all politically relevant inquiries and cases linked to Banco Master, without selective disclosure. At a campaign event, the PT candidate also presented a health plan based on artificial intelligence and integrated care from scheduling to surgery.

item.title: Lula diz que é preciso parar com 'babaquice de fazer superávit' para governo investir
item.description: At a rally in Curitiba, Lula called for an end to fiscal surpluses to allow greater government investment, arguing that Brazil's main debt burden is the R$1.3 trillion paid in interest. His remarks contradict the PT's official campaign plan, which pledges responsible fiscal policy and spending controls to lower interest rates and stimulate growth.

item.title: Lindbergh pede investigação de Flávio por vínculo com Careca do INSS
item.description: Federal deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) requested the PGR to investigate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) over alleged ties to companies linked to Careca do INSS, described as a operator of an embezzlement scheme involving social security benefits. The complaint highlights shared addresses between Flávio's company and 16 firms tied to Antunes, as well as accounting connections with individuals under FBI investigation.

item.title: Fachin dá tiro no pé e caso Moraes pode ficar para "Dia de São Nunca"
item.description: Supreme Court President Edson Fachin, by disagreeing with adding André Mendonça's conduct analysis to the Sept. 15 agenda, opened the door for justices to request adjournments and block the vote on Alexandre de Moraes. Without an agreement to judge both cases in the same session, the process could drag on for years.

item.title: Servidores do BC orientaram Vorcaro antes de reunião com Campos Neto que autorizou compra do Will Bank
item.description: Federal Police investigations indicate that senior Banco Central supervision officials informally advised Daniel Vorcaro on how to present arguments in meetings with Roberto Campos Neto, including through a WhatsApp group called “Master”. The messages addressed Banco Master’s capitalization, Banif tax credits, the sale of Voiter, and the acquisition of Will Bank. The report also mentions Flávio Bolsonaro in probes involving the Dark Horse fund and funds linked to Vorcaro in the United States.

item.title: O esquema especial de segurança que STF terá para a sessão de terça-feira
item.description: The Federal District will deploy reinforced security around the STF on Tuesday, the 15th, with police, drones, online monitoring, cameras and possible blockades ahead of a ruling on whether to open an investigation involving Justice Alexandre de Moraes and Daniel Vorcaro. Romeu Zema called supporters to protest in Brasília, while the STF still determines the unprecedented procedure for the session.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro 'esconde' Queiroz em palco de evento no RJ, puxa coro contra Moraes e repete que relação com Vorcaro foi 'privada'
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro downplayed the impact of lifting the Master Case secrecy on his campaign, defending the private nature of 'Dark Horse' funding and attacking Moraes and Lula. At a rally in RJ, he led chants against opponents and called for transparency in other investigations.

item.title: Lula ataca Mendonça em comício e tenta reagir à crise: 'Vão começar a aparecer as orgias do Vorcaro, sacanagem com muita gente da política'
item.description: At a rally in Curitiba, Lula accused Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça of selectively leaking investigative details and called for full disclosure of the case files. He also attacked the Bolsonaro family, sought to link Flávio Bolsonaro to the INSS scandal, and said parties hosted by banker Daniel Vorcaro could expose people involved in misconduct.

item.title: Lula diz sobre Master que 'quem fez putaria vai ser desmascarado'
item.description: On Saturday (12), in Curitiba, President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva (PT), a reelection candidate, criticized Supreme Court Justice Andre Mendonca, the relator in the Banco Master case. Lula said that those involved in wrongdoing would be exposed.

item.title: Lula: queda de sigilo vai desmascarar quem fez "putaria" junto com Vorcaro
item.description: Lula advocates for lifting the secrecy of the Master Case to expose alleged corruption and connections between Vorcaro and politicians, criticizing Minister Andre Mendonça for selective leaks. During a speech in Curitiba, he stated that the Bolsonaro family will not escape investigations and reinforced the need for judicial reforms.

item.title: Relatório da PF sobre “Dark Horse” contraria versão de Flávio
item.description: The Federal Police report on the funding of the film 'Dark Horse' contradicts Flávio Bolsonaro's version by indicating that the Havengate fund was inactive before the $2 million transfer in 2025. The PF notes that the fund, originally created for real estate purposes, was revived to finance the production, while Flávio claimed it was exclusive to the film.

item.title: Novas frentes de investigação: Vorcaro usou agência de luxo para beneficiar 'dezenas de autoridades' em viagens no exterior, além de Ciro Nogueira, aponta PF
item.description: Federal Police investigate evidence that banker Daniel Vorcaro used a luxury agency to distribute benefits to dozens of officials during international trips, including Senator Ciro Nogueira. Investigators requested documents from the Supreme Court to identify all beneficiaries, expanding the Master case investigations.

item.title: França chama Tarcísio de “Kinder Ovo” com surpresinha “bolsonarista”
item.description: Márcio França (PSB), Haddad's running mate, labeled Tarcísio de Freitas as a 'Kinder Egg with a Bolsonarist surprise', criticizing his technical image and health policies. França questioned the effectiveness of Tarcísio's anti-drug crackdown and noted the tight race between candidates.

item.title: Internado com pneumonia, Ronaldo Caiado diz que terá alta no domingo (13/9)
item.description: Presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) was hospitalized with pneumonia at Hospital Vila Nova Star in São Paulo and is expected to be discharged on Sunday (13/9). He will resume his electoral campaign on Monday (14/9).

item.title: Confira a agenda dos presidenciáveis neste fim de semana (12 e 13)
item.description: Presidential candidates mobilize their bases over the weekend with rallies, caravans, social gatherings, and health events such as breast cancer awareness. The schedule includes regional actions, leafleting, roundtable discussions, and visits to vulnerable communities. The main figures involved maintain neutral stances in public statements.

item.title: PF e PGR pediram sigilo de investigação sobre Flávio
item.description: The Federal Police and the Attorney General's Office initially requested the secrecy of the investigation into Flávio Bolsonaro over suspicions of irregular funding for the film 'Dark Horse', but Minister André Mendonça of the Supreme Court removed the secrecy. The case involves legal and political investigations that may affect the lawmaker's trajectory in the 2026 elections.

item.title: Gleisi e Janja chamam Moro de “algoz” de Lula
item.description: Gleisi Hoffmann and Janja da Silva criticized Sergio Moro, calling him 'executioner' of Lula during a rally in Curitiba, linking his imprisonment to Lava Jato. The statements were made without naming Moro directly, but making clear references to his conviction and Lula's imprisonment.

item.title: Leia a íntegra da decisão de Fachin que separa casos de Moraes e Mendonça
item.description: Supreme Court Chief Justice Edson Fachin rejected Minister Alexandre de Moraes' request to unify the hearings of Petitions 16.704 and 16.662. He decided to keep the analysis of Petition 16.662 separate and scheduled Petition 16.704 for September 23rd.

item.title: Os ataques do governo a Jorge Messias e como governo e AGU criaram estratégia para Fachin sair da inércia
item.description: The government and AGU devised a strategy for Supreme Court Justice Edson Fachin to intervene and reverse the ruling removing Federal Police Director Andrei Rodrigues, amid political pressure and criticism of Attorney General Jorge Messias. The case involves allegations of clandestine monitoring of Justice André Mendonça and suspicions of bias in the fake news investigation, fueling tensions between the PT and the STF leadership.

item.title: 'Crise Master' no STF: em Curitiba, Lula diz que 'ninguém pode ser ministro da Suprema Corte para ficar rico'
item.description: During a campaign in Curitiba, Lula stated that no one can be a Supreme Court minister to get rich, treating the position as a sacred role. He emphasized that his son Lulinha will not be shielded in ongoing investigations and called for full transparency in the Master case. The Supreme Court is examining messages exchanged between justices and former banker Daniel Vorcaro.

item.title: Fachin marca julgamento sobre conduta de Mendonça no Master para dia 23/9
item.description: The President of the Supreme Federal Court (STF), Minister Edson Fachin, scheduled for September 23, 2026 the trial regarding the conduct of Minister André Mendonça in the Master case. Fachin denied Alexandre de Moraes' request to jointly try PET 16.704 with other investigations. The trial will be conducted by the Plenary, analyzing Mendonça's conduct during the rapporteurship of PETs 15041 and 15556.

item.title: Fachin nega julgar Moraes e Mendonça juntos; marca outra sessão para dia 23
item.description: STF President Edson Fachin rejected the request to jointly try ministers Alexandre de Moraes and André Mendonça, keeping September 15 for Moraes and scheduling September 23 for Mendonça, citing that the second process is still under preliminary investigation.

item.title: Fachin nega pedido para julgar Mendonça junto com Moraes e marca outra sessão para o dia 23
item.description: The President of the STF, Edson Fachin, denied the request to judge Minister Alexandre de Moraes together with former banker Daniel Vorcaro, keeping only the investigation against Moraes in the December 15 session. A new session was scheduled for December 23. The decision maintains focus on analyzing the minister's conduct and his possible relationship with the owner of Banco Master.

item.title: Janja e Gleisi dançam com “onça”, e Lula ri durante ato em Curitiba
item.description: At a campaign rally in Curitiba, President Lula laughed alongside Janja and Gleisi as a jaguar - used as Gleisi's campaign mascot - danced on stage. The event is part of the PT's tour through southern Brazil, including stops in Porto Alegre and Curitiba, where Lula was imprisoned in 2018 on corruption convictions later annulled by the Supreme Court.

item.title: Gilmar reforça pedido para liberação dos dados de celular de Vorcaro
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Gilmar Mendes requested the release of Daniel Vorcaro's phone data to STF President Edson Fachin, arguing that asymmetric access undermines parity among ministers in the case analysis. Gilmar emphasized the need for all ministers to have full access to information to form independent judgments, threatening to involve the Federal Police if access is not granted. The case is linked to corruption investigations involving the Master bank.

item.title: Padilha diz que Tarcísio mente: “61% da Tabela SUS Paulista vêm da União”
item.description: Minister of Health Alexandre Padilha accused São Paulo governor Tarcísio de Freitas of lying when claiming credit for funding the SUS Paulista table, stating that 61% of the resources come from the federal government. Padilha attended the launch of Fernando Haddad's program and emphasized that the model already existed in previous administrations.

item.title: Fachin nega julgar Moraes e Mendonça juntos e marca sessão do relator do Master para 23 de setembro
item.description: STF President Edson Fachin rejected Alexandre de Moraes' request to merge investigations against him and André Mendonça. Tuesday's session will address only messages between Daniel Vorcaro and Moraes, while Mendonça's conduct analysis is scheduled for September 23. Moraes claims there's a risk of contradictory decisions if cases are separated.

item.title: Vorcaro se gabou de proximidade com governo Lula: ‘Igual irmãos Batista’
item.description: Banker Daniel Vorcaro referenced his proximity to the Lula administration, comparing himself to the Batista brothers of J&F, in a conversation revealed by O Estado de S. Paulo. The dialogue occurred after criticisms of Banco Master and was part of an investigation into the institution. Vorcaro suggested using the mention of government ties as a marketing strategy.

item.title: A preocupação da campanha de Lula com queda nas pesquisas em Minas Gerais
item.description: Lula's re-election campaign is concerned about declining poll numbers in Minas Gerais, where Flávio Bolsonaro surpassed the PT candidate in the latest Quaest survey. The institutional crisis involving the STF and Daniel Vorcaro is impacting Lula's performance, particularly due to his ties with Minister Moraes. The campaign views Minas as a strategic state given its large independent electorate.

item.title: Brics critica medidas comerciais unilaterais em cúpula da Índia
item.description: BRICS countries criticized unilateral trade measures and protectionist barriers at a summit in India, calling for the strengthening of the WTO. Leaders such as Xi Jinping and Narendra Modi emphasized the need for cooperation and adherence to multilateral rules.

item.title: Defesa de Flávio tentou tirar investigação de caso Dark Horse de Dino
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's lawyers attempted, at least four times, to move the 'Dark Horse' case investigation to Justice André Mendonça, but Justice Flávio Dino retained part of the probe under his jurisdiction. The dispute involves suspicions of money laundering, currency evasion, and misuse of parliamentary amendments linked to the film's production. The defense accuses a supposed manipulation of competence rules to create an artificial preemption of Dino.
